title: Black metal pickaxe

infobox.Crafting Materials: Yggdrasil wood x3, Black metal x45

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
The Black metal pickaxe is the fourth pickaxe. It can be used to mine Black marble, Soft tissue, Ancient sword, Ancient armor, and Flametal ore vein, in addition to what previous pickaxes can mine.
Its primary attack is a melee attack that destroys ground. It does not have a secondary attack.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • The attack hitbox reaches below the player's feet, allowing to dig down. This easily causes a 33% damage penalty for hitting the ground when not above or very close to the target.

Black metal pickaxe

Internal ID: PickaxeBlackMetal | Type: Pickaxe | Source: Forge | Usage: Mining | Wielding: Two-handed | Crafting Materials: Yggdrasil wood x3, Black metal x45 | Attack speed: 1.4 s | Hitbox: 1.8 range, 120 angle, 1.0 height, 0.2 ray, vertical | Movement speed: -5%

Introduction. The Black metal pickaxe is the fourth pickaxe. It can be used to mine Black marble, Soft tissue, Ancient sword, Ancient armor, and Flametal ore vein, in addition to what previous pickaxes can mine.
Its primary attack is a melee attack that destroys ground. It does not have a secondary attack.

Notes. • The attack hitbox reaches below the player's feet, allowing to dig down. This easily causes a 33% damage penalty for hitting the ground when not above or very close to the target.
